summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building vision-guided robotic manipulation and pick-and-place systems on ROS2 and Jetson platforms. Built a contact-aware grasping pipeline combining visual servoing, ToF sensing, and TensorRT-optimized perception models, and derived full forward and inverse kinematics for 6-DoF and 5-DoF robotic arms validated in MoveIt and RViz. Skilled in PyTorch training and evaluation pipelines, model quantization, and edge deployment (ONNX/TensorRT) for reliable, low-latency robot control.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for edge deployment.
Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built PyTorch preprocessing and training pipelines using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder for a transformer document understanding model.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency in a vision-guided robotic manipulation pipeline, resolving 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture).
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup, 17.6 to 92 FPS) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz in ROS 2.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated synthetic data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation — near-lossless compression for edge deployment.
